results.prompt: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do eligible employees receive per calendar year?
results.answer:
Eligible employees and interns receive up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year.

results.prompt: What are the annual vacation accrual tiers for 1-6, 7-10, and 11+ years of service?
results.answer:
The annual vacation accrual tiers are as follows:
*   1 to 6 years of service: 20 days per year.
*   7 to 10 years of service: 21 days per year.
*   11 years and above of service: 22 days per year.

Source: ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES, gs://m3-hr-agent-20260720-zken-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf

results.prompt: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit on a global business trip?
results.answer:
The daily meal reimbursement limit for individual meals on global business trips is capped at US $120 (or equivalent) per employee per day. This is not a per diem, and all meal expenses must be individually detailed with receipts.

Source: ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES, gs://m3-hr-agent-20260720-zken-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf

results.prompt: Within how many days must medical insurance claims be submitted?
results.answer:
All medical claims must be submitted within 30 days of the treatment date. Late submissions may be rejected by the insurance provider.
